subject: Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘INLA’:  object ‘fm_identical_CRS’ is not exported by 'namespace:fmesher'

messages.author: 99ec74e18ccd1ba8
messages.subject: Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘INLA’:  object ‘fm_identical_CRS’ is not exported by 'namespace:fmesher'
parts: I am trying to use INLA, but every time I run library(INLA) I get the error "Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘INLA’:  object ‘fm_identical_CRS’ is not exported by 'namespace:fmesher'".  My version of INLA is 23.09.09, my version of fmesher is 0.5.0, my version of R is 4.3.2 and my version of RStuio is 2023.12.0+369.  I am on a mac (if that is important).  Any suggestions for how to resolve this error?

messages.author: 9a89594e7fcb7aad
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘INLA’:  object ‘fm_identical_CRS’ is not exported by 'namespace:fmesher'
